tickets.background:
[::INSPECTION_FLAGGED::]
This ticket has been flagged by the ABC Inspection Pipeline after completing the implementation lifecycle (make → plan → start → review → resolve). The actual source code was rigorously analyzed against three criteria:

  A — Contract Translation:   Are all Precondition/Postcondition/Invariant contracts accurately translated into test code?
  B — Violation Detection:    Can every contract violation be detected by an existing test assertion?
  C — Test Precision:         Are tests precise and unambiguous (no broad assertions, no missing edge cases)?

One or more ABC violations were confirmed. This ticket is hereby remanded for re-implementation. Every violation must be fully resolved, and every contract must be fulfilled in this final implementation round. Complete it this time.

- [Goal] Fully define the type system foundation for the siprs crate: newtype ID identifiers (AccountId, CallId, AudioSourceId) as NonZeroU64 with BiMap runtime-to-native mapping; complete SipEventPayload enum with 25+ variants spanning all event categories; RegistrationState machine with 7 states and 8 transition rules; CallState machine with 13 states and all transition paths.
- [Purpose] These types form the shared language across all siprs modules (API, event system, state machines, FFI bridge, audio processing). Without them, module boundaries use raw integers (u64, pjsua_acc_id, pjsua_call_id) leading to type confusion, parameter swap bugs, and opaque error messages. The BiMap specifically solves PJSUA id reuse — native IDs are recycled by PJSUA after session teardown, and public API consumers must never see recycled IDs.
- [Motivation] P0-5 (Event System) delivered SipEventPayload, EventBus, and basic CallState as a Minimum Viable Event System. However, P0-5 used placeholder AccountId(pub u64)/CallId(pub u64) with NonZeroU64 requirements stubbed out, only 6 CallState variants (vs 13 required by N0026), and no RegistrationState. These gaps must be resolved before downstream tickets (P3-1 Public API, P5-1 Call API) can depend on correct types.
- [Constraints] (1) model/ module is currently gated behind #[cfg(feature = "sqlite-storage")] — id_design_newtype.rs must be made unconditionally compilable. (2) BiMap must use existing dependencies (dashmap) — no new crate additions without justification. (3) SipEventPayload must remain #[non_exhaustive] — existing downstream consumers (P0-5 tests, EventBus, AccountEventReceiver) must continue to compile. (4) RegistrationState and CallState must be Copy+Clone — they are used in hot paths (per-event, per-call). (5) RFC 12 states for CallState are actually 13: Disconnected and Failed are separate terminal states.

CallState follows the full outgoing path (New→Calling→Trying→Ringing→Connecting→Active) and termination path (Active→Disconnecting→Disconnected). [Error case] AccountId::from_u64(0) returns Err(ZeroValue). CallState::transition(New→Active) returns Err(TransitionError). RegistrationState::transition(Idle→Disabled) returns Err(TransitionError). BiMap::get_native(unknown_id) returns None. SipEventPayload variant enum compiled with _ => {} wildcard (non_exhaustive check).

[Edge case] BiMap handles native ID reuse: insert(a1, n1), remove(a1), insert(a2, n1) — get_runtime(n1) returns a2. RegistrationState transition Expired→Registering (auto retry) followed by Failed (no network) then Registering again (retry). CallState transfer path Active→Transferring→Disconnecting (NOTIFY fail) verifies transfer failure branch. CallState Failed reached from Ringing (4xx), EarlyMedia (5xx), and Connecting (6xx) via 3 distinct paths.

tickets.invariants:
- [Normal condition] Newtype ID construction: AccountId::from_u64(x) succeeds iff x > 0, returns ZeroValue error iff x == 0. BiMap insert/lookup round-trip: insert(r, n) guarantees get_native(r) == Some(n) and get_runtime(n) == Some(r) until remove(r) is called. RegistrationState transitions: every transition follows exactly one of the 8 defined rules; no implicit transitions exist. CallState transitions: every transition follows the DAG defined in §18.1; all non-terminal states can reach Disconnected or Failed.
- [Error invariant] Zero-value ID construction (from_u64(0)) never succeeds — returns Err(SipErrorKind::ZeroValue). BiMap never loses data on concurrent access — dashmap interior mutability guarantees crash-consistency. Invalid state machine transitions never mutate internal state — Err is returned, state unchanged. RegistrationState::Failed and Expired do not prevent make_call() — this invariant is enforced by the absence of registration checks in the Call API.
- [Internal state invariant] BiMap internal state: for all (r, n) pairs, r is unique (RuntimeId is the primary key). NativeId n may be reused; the newest (r, n) pair wins on insert. RegistrationState machine: internal transition table enumerates exactly (7 states × 7 targets) = 49 boolean predicates, of which exactly 10 are true (the 8 rules plus 2 reflexive). CallState machine: transition table enumerates exactly (13 states × 13 targets) = 169 boolean predicates, covering all outgoing/incoming/hold/transfer paths.
- [Boundary invariant] AccountId/CallId/AudioSourceId NonZeroU64 domain: [1, u64::MAX]. BiMap capacity: unbounded (backed by dashmap). EventBus capacity impact: AccountId/CallId size is 8 bytes each, negligible on bus capacity. RegistrationState transitions: Failed→Registering retry must not cause infinite loop — controlled by ClientConfig::registration_retry_count (P3-1 scope). CallState: max_calls concurrent limit enforced by Call API (P3-1 scope), not by state machine itself.

tickets.boyScoutPlan:
## Boy Scout Rule — Translatability Plan for P4-1

### Proactive improvements in touched files

**id_design_newtype.rs** (new implementation):
- Define `AccountId`, `CallId`, `AudioSourceId` as distinct newtype structs — prevents parameter swap between `fn make_call(call: CallId, account: AccountId)` and `fn register(account: AccountId)` (type-level noun distinction)
- `from_u64()` uses Result return — rejects 0 at the type boundary, eliminating downstream zero-check code
- `BiMap` type parameters named `RuntimeId` and `NativeId` — the type itself documents which direction maps where
- `insert(runtime_id, native_id)` → `get_native(runtime_id)` reads as "insert runtime→native pair, then look up native by runtime" — full translatable narrative

**registr_state_machine.rs** (new implementation):
- `fn transition(self, target: RegistrationState) -> Result<RegistrationState, TransitionError>` reads as "transition from current state to target, return new state or error"
- Internal transition table as a const 7×7 matrix — each cell `VALID` or `INVALID` reads as "from row, can I go to column?"
- `is_terminal()` on Failed and Expired — noun-like on the state itself, not an external check

**call_state_model.rs** (refactor from re-export to canonical definition):
- 13-state enum with doc comments on each variant documenting the transition semantics — the enum itself is executable prose
- `fn transition(self, target: CallState) -> Result<CallState, TransitionError>` — single source of truth for all valid transitions
- `fn can_transition_to(self, target: CallState) -> bool` — predicate reads as "can this state reach the target?"

**event_model_payload_bus.rs** (modify stub replacement):
- Replace `pub struct AccountId(pub u64)` with `pub use crate::model::id_design_newtype::AccountId;` — the import itself documents "this is the canonical AccountId"
- All 10+ new SipEventPayload variants follow the existing doc-comment pattern: `/// [category] [description of when this variant fires]`

### Existing code improvement outside immediate scope
- `m20_callstate_mapping.rs`: After call_state_model.rs defines the canonical 13-state CallState, refactor m20_callstate_mapping.rs to `pub use crate::state::call_state_model::CallState;` instead of its own definition. This eliminates duplicated type definition (currently 6 states vs RFC 13).

- `error_design_siperror.rs`: If SipErrorKind needs ZeroValue/TransitionError variants, add them following the existing naming pattern (noun-based variants).

N0028 defines DTMF methods (Inband, SipInfo, Rfc4733). N0032 defines AsyncAudioSource trait with RPITIT and SyncSourceAdapter. N0048 defines incoming call handling and REFER/blind transfer.

### Goal
Define and implement DTMF specification (DtmfMethod, DtmfReceivedInfo with method field), AsyncAudioSource adapter types (ErasedAudioSource, SyncAudioSource, SyncSourceAdapter), and IncomingCall/Refer transfer types per RFC N0028/N0032/N0048. Replace existing stubs in src/api/ with full typed implementations and register new modules in api/mod.rs.

### Purpose
Provide type-safe DTMF signalling primitives for SIP call control. Enable downstream crates to implement custom async audio sources for AudioMixer. Expose incoming call metadata (URI, headers, codecs, early media) and REFER-based transfer capabilities to application code via typed events.

### Motivation
Current stub files prevent compilation of dependent modules and block P5-1 (Call API) which depends on DTMF types and DtmfReceived event. Incoming call handling is required for zasso's call routing and auto-attendant features. Audio source abstraction is mandatory for the AudioMixer integration pipeline.

### Constraints
MSRV 1.95 — RPITIT stable; use native async fn in traits with ErasedAudioSource for dynamic dispatch. Do NOT add new crate dependencies — all required derives (Clone, Debug, PartialEq) are std. Maintain backward compatibility with existing DtmfReceivedInfo consumers (P0-5 event model). The DtmfMethod enum in m20_dtmfsent_twophase.rs must stay separate or be unified — unification is preferred but needs careful migration.
